_comment: Reference session config for fingerprint2. Underscore-prefixed keys are ignored (inactive/comment).
_comment_runtime: Optional runtime settings: defaults are frameRate=30, timeMeasurementsEnabled=false, logLevel=notice, logDestination=console.
_comment_recording: Composite recording: press R to start/stop. Session option startRecordingOnFirstWake starts recording after first wake from hibernation. Audio+video mux happens automatically on stop/exit.
_comment_autosnapshots: Full-res EXR autosnapshots (drawing-auto): gated by pause/hibernation and no-overlap. Defaults: enabled=false, intervalSec=20, jitterSec=7.
_comment_output: Output routing. renderToDisplay=true (default) presents the shared rectangular output on the window. syphonMode selects Syphon streams: 'off' (default), 'composite' (main tonemapped rectangular output), 'layers' (per-layer streams for layers flagged syphonPublish:true in their config; each layer stream is square at min(syphonWidth,syphonHeight) per side, matching the composite's center square region), or 'composite+layers'. Performer cues are drawn on-screen only and never reach Syphon or recordings. To run headless and publish a fixed-size Syphon feed, set renderToDisplay=false and specify syphonWidth/syphonHeight.
_comment_audio: Audio file-replay mode is ACTIVE via an all-file audioSources rig. To switch to a live mic, comment out audioSources and uncomment micDeviceName (or give audioSources device entries).
_comment_audioBufferSize: Shared by both modes (it is the analysis FFT window): always keep it set. Live mic uses the same window as file playback so a recorded take and its replay analyse identically.
_comment_startPosition: Per-FILE replay start: add "startPosition": "MM:SS" to an audioSources file entry to seek THAT file. The file owner's value wins; lanes sharing one file start together. (Replaces the old shared top-level sourceAudioStartPosition.)
_comment_video: Video file mode is ACTIVE. To switch to camera, move the underscore from the camera keys to the file keys.
